recordActivity.introIndoor: Record a treadmill or other indoor session. No GPS is used, and you can enter the distance your machine shows when you finish.

indoorDistance.title: Distance

indoorDistance.estimateLearned_other: Estimated from {{formattedCount}} steps using your stride. Change it to match your treadmill and the app keeps learning.
indoorDistance.estimateRough_one: A rough estimate from {{formattedCount}} step with a typical stride. Enter what your treadmill shows and the app learns yours.

indoorDistance.invalid: Enter a distance of zero or more.

errors.saveHint: Your recording is kept on this phone. Try again.

discard.title: Discard this activity?
discard.message: The recorded route and stats will be deleted.

recordActivity.carriedOver: This recording started at {{time}} and was still running on this phone.
recordActivity.intro: Record a walk, run or ride with your phone’s GPS. Recording continues with the screen locked.

permission.denied: SparkyFitness needs location access to record your route. You can allow it in Settings.
permission.servicesOff: Location services are turned off. Turn them on in Settings to record.

androidTips.title: Recording with the screen off
androidTips.body: Some phones stop apps that run in the background. If a recording has gaps, set SparkyFitness to “Unrestricted” in the phone’s battery settings.
